entries.name: cublasSgemm
entries.signature: cublasStatus_t cublasSgemm(cublasHandle_t handle, cublasOperation_t transa, cublasOperation_t transb, int m, int n, int k, const float *alpha, const float *A, int lda, const float *B, int ldb, const float *beta, float *C, int ldc)
entries.notes: Single-precision GEMM on GPU. C = alpha * op(A) * op(B) + beta * C. Auto-uses Tensor Cores on Volta+ with CUBLAS_TENSOR_OP_MATH. Only beneficial for matrices >= 64x64; smaller matrices are faster on CPU.

entries.name: cublasDgemm
entries.signature: cublasStatus_t cublasDgemm(cublasHandle_t handle, cublasOperation_t transa, cublasOperation_t transb, int m, int n, int k, const double *alpha, const double *A, int lda, const double *B, int ldb, const double *beta, double *C, int ldc)
entries.notes: Double-precision GEMM on GPU. Same interface as Sgemm but FP64. Tensor Core acceleration on A100+ (FP64 Tensor Cores).

entries.name: cublasSnrm2
entries.signature: cublasStatus_t cublasSnrm2(cublasHandle_t handle, int n, const float *x, int incx, float *result)
entries.notes: Euclidean norm (L2) of a vector. result = sqrt(sum(x[i]^2)). Only beneficial for vectors > 10K elements.

entries.name: cublasCreate
entries.notes: Create cuBLAS context handle. Cache this — one per GPU. Creating/destroying per call is a performance bug.

entries.name: cublasSgemmStridedBatched
entries.signature: cublasStatus_t cublasSgemmStridedBatched(cublasHandle_t handle, cublasOperation_t transa, cublasOperation_t transb, int m, int n, int k, const float *alpha, const float *A, int lda, long long strideA, const float *B, int ldb, long long strideB, const float *beta, float *C, int ldc, long long strideC, int batchCount)
entries.notes: Batched GEMM — computes batchCount independent matrix multiplies in one launch. Ideal for many small matrices (e.g., per-point covariance computation in SLAM). Much more efficient than launching batchCount individual Sgemm calls.

steps.notes: Create cuBLAS handle. Do this once at startup, not per call.
Enable Tensor Core math on Volta+. Uses TF32 on Ampere for ~8x throughput on FP32 inputs.
Bind handle to a CUDA stream for async execution. Required for overlapping compute and transfer.
